summary: Coya Therapeutics filed an Item 8.01 8-K on September 15, 2026, disclosing via press release that the 100th patient enrolled in its Phase 2/3 ALSTARS trial (NCT07161999) of COYA 302, a low-dose IL-2 plus CTLA-4 Ig combination, in ALS. Full enrollment of 120 participants is expected with topline data in early Q2 2027. The trial randomizes 1:1:1 to two dosing regimens or placebo over 24 weeks, then a blinded extension. This is a routine clinical milestone, not a special situation; no deal terms.
